name: smwpatches-death-counter-version-1
title: Death Counter Version 1.2
description:
This patch is the original Death Counter from Super Dram World 2, coded by Thomas/Kaizoman, now converted to be SA-1 compatible. This version works with the SA-1 pack v1.32, and SA-1 v1.33 available on GitHub. It is also compatible with the Retry System v2.06.
There is an included readme which gives usage notes and explanations on what you may need to change.
